n50a826f46b.headline: State media: Court jails Vietnamese tycoon for 21 years for $146 mn fraud
n50a826f46b.summary: A Vietnamese court sentenced tycoon Trinh Van Quyet to 21 years in prison for a $146 million fraud. He was among 50 defendants found guilty in a corruption case targeting business elites.
n50a826f46b.why: Corruption cases against major business figures in Vietnam can affect investor confidence in governance and the country's corporate sector.

n7082465140.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 closed down 4,451.28 points at 31,458.42 on Monday. The fall came as world markets reacted to fears about the US economy.

n0141b1646f.headline: Timeline: Events leading up to Bangladesh PM Sheikh Hasina’s resignation
n0141b1646f.summary: A timeline traces how protests over the quota system for public jobs escalated into a campaign to oust Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. The movement led to her resignation.
n0141b1646f.why: Political instability in Bangladesh, a major garment exporter, can affect investor confidence and the country's export-driven economy.

n6486fb1820.headline: State Secretary: Brussels Racketeers, Would Strip Member States of Right to Protect Themselves
n6486fb1820.summary: A Hungarian parliamentary state secretary says Hungary is being punished with a record fine to force it into line. The official criticised Brussels over the measure.

ne196e35d0c.headline: Japanese yen surges to 7-month high as US economy worries mount
ne196e35d0c.summary: The yen rose to seven-month highs against the dollar on Monday as traders unwound carry trades and the dollar broadly weakened. Concerns about the US economy weighed on sentiment.
ne196e35d0c.why: The yen is a major funding currency for carry trades, so sharp moves in it can ripple through global currency and bond markets.
ne196e35d0c.why_moved: Traders unwound carry trades and the dollar broadly weakened amid concerns about the US economy, pushing the yen to seven-month highs.

na55ee5ce78.headline: Shares at PSX shed over 1,100 points in line with global markets

na55ee5ce78.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange's KSE-100 is the main benchmark for Pakistani equities and reflects local investor sentiment.
na55ee5ce78.why_moved: An analyst attributes the fall to the market reacting to a global sell-off.

na6a28cf260.headline: GDS Said to Seek as Much as $1B for Data Center Push Outside China
na6a28cf260.summary: Singapore-based data center firm GDS is reportedly planning to expand its operations in Southeast Asia and is seeking as much as $1 billion. The report does not name the financing source.
na6a28cf260.why: GDS is a major Asian data center operator, and its expansion reflects strong demand for cloud and AI computing capacity.

n40270a1dae.headline: Japan's Nikkei Crash by 20% from July Highs, Crypto Rout Continues
n40270a1dae.summary: Japan's Nikkei and Topix indexes collapsed more than 20% from their July highs during a sharp sell-off in Asian trading hours. The headline also notes that the crypto rout continued.
n40270a1dae.why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark stock index of 225 large companies, and the Topix tracks all eligible Tokyo Stock Exchange First Section companies. A drop of this size signals a major bear-market move in Japanese equities.

n63824c0ca7.summary: The Australian Federal Police are investigating phishing scams targeting around 2,000 cryptocurrency wallets using new cybercriminal tactics.
